_conventions.description: Binding coordination rules for shared_state.json. This file is the single coordination surface for the SA Dropship Agent Crew.
_conventions.authority: README.md is the source of truth. If any agent output, prompt, or reasoning conflicts with README.md, README.md wins and the conflict must be escalated to the human operator.
rules: Only the Supervisor Agent writes the top-level structure of this file. Sub-agents append only to their own namespace.
No agent imports another agent directly. All coordination flows through the Supervisor via this file.
Every write includes: timestamp (ISO 8601), agent, confidence (1-10), source.
Any field marked UNVERIFIED must be surfaced to the human by the Supervisor. It must never be silently used in a downstream calculation, price, or recommendation.
confidence is the writing agent's self-assessed certainty on a 1-10 scale. It is not a margin, a probability, or a price.
source must be a real, checkable reference: a URL, a document, a dataset, or an explicit 'sandbox test'. Words such as 'assumed', 'estimated', 'typical', or 'industry standard' are not sources.
All cost math lives only in tools/landed_cost.py. All HS code, duty and VAT math lives only in tools/customs.py. Agents import from them; they never re-implement the formulas.
Every landed-cost calculation must include 15% VAT on the customs value. There are no exceptions.
Any net margin below 20% (after product + shipping + duty + 15% VAT + payment fees + ad CPA) must be rejected and explained, never approved.
_conventions.hard_stops_reference: README.md section 2 - the full non-negotiable HARD STOP list. Do not duplicate it here; the README is authoritative and duplication invites drift.
_conventions.hitl_gates_reference: README.md section 5 - the full HITL gate list. Approval format: state WHAT, WHY, COST, RISK. Human replies APPROVED or REJECTED plus reason.
_conventions.namespace_init_note: Namespaces below were initialised by the Supervisor with no findings. An initialised namespace is scaffolding, not evidence: confidence is null, verified is false, and findings is empty until a sub-agent appends real, sourced data.

sessions.scope_authority: README-DERIVED. The operator described this as 'Phase 0, defined in README section 9', and that citation is CORRECT: README section 9 is 'BUILD PHASES', and 'Phase 0 - Bootstrap' specifies exactly this consolidated-PR scope. CORRECTION TO AN EARLIER ENTRY IN THIS RECORD: an interim version of this field claimed the citation was incorrect and that 'phase' does not appear in README.md. That claim was WRONG. It was made against a stale local README, because the execution environment was re-created mid-session (fresh shallow clone) while the operator had already amended README.md on main in commit d3d5993. The operator was right and the agent was wrong. Recorded so the error is not inherited by a future session.

agent_error_log.error: Told the human operator their README section 9 'Phase 0' citation was incorrect, and asserted the string 'phase' does not appear in README.md.
agent_error_log.cause: Read a stale README. The environment was re-created between turns via a fresh shallow clone that restored working-tree files from a snapshot taken before the operator amended the README on main.
agent_error_log.detection: git ls-remote showed main at d3d5993 while the local base was 898ab3a; git show d3d5993:README.md revealed the new section 9 BUILD PHASES.
agent_error_log.correction: Re-read the README in full from origin/main, confirmed the operator's citation was correct, took main's README verbatim, and corrected this state record.
agent_error_log.lesson: A README read at session start is not authoritative for the whole session. Re-read it from origin/main whenever git shows main has moved. This is the failure mode README section 1 warns about: reasoning conflicting with the contract.

git_integration.problem: The environment was re-created mid-session (fresh shallow clone). The remote branch arena/01a0e3b8-okay held commit 680ab02 (the state-file scaffold) which was absent locally, while the local branch held f396311 (the bootstrap additions). The two were siblings, both children of 898ab3a, so a naive push would have DELETED 680ab02 from the remote.
git_integration.resolution: Merged 680ab02 into the local branch (preserving it as an ancestor), then took main's README verbatim on top. No force-push, no history rewrite, no branch deletion. The push is a clean fast-forward because 680ab02 is an ancestor of HEAD.
git_integration.note: git merge of origin/main was refused with 'refusing to merge unrelated histories' because the shallow clone grafted the history boundary. Rather than pass --allow-unrelated-histories (semantically wrong: the histories ARE related, sharing 898ab3a), the merge was avoided because main's only change was README.md, which was taken directly with git checkout.
